source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Reduce maintenance surface of the reporting module by deleting export formats nobody uses.
constraints: Do not break any existing scheduled or on-demand report.
input.context: Reporting service (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types). Exporters are registered by format name in src/exporters/index.js; scheduled reports pick an exporter by name.

ground_truth.material_issue: config/report-schedules.json still schedules 'finance-monthly' with format 'xml'; after the change getExporter('xml') throws and the finance ledger import breaks. Found by searching for the format name; tests and typecheck pass.
required_observations: A scheduled report (finance-monthly) still uses format xml
That schedule will throw 'unknown export format'
